eras.title: Incorporation
eras.line: Pierce Hawkes incorporates the company on a single floor of Hawkes Tower, on the view that a medical company should own a category, not compete for it.

image.alt: The lobby of Hawkes Tower in daylight.

eras.title: The charter office
eras.line: Voss takes the charter office. Every product, statement and filing is checked against what the company said it would be.

image.alt: An office on the Hawkes Tower floor in daylight.

eras.title: A quarter to report
eras.line: Director Hale joins the board and gives the company a quarter it can report on.

image.alt: A Hawkes Tower interior in daylight.

eras.title: The Zurich desk
eras.line: Lang opens the Zurich capital desk and takes the calendar: filing dates, investor commitments and the date each product reaches market.

image.alt: A conference room on the 58th floor in daylight.

eras.title: The Hawkes line
eras.line: Eight products, eight categories and a combined 71% share, held without a break since 2009. The date has not moved.

image.alt: The board room on the 58th floor in daylight.

ph-origins.name: PH Origins
ph-origins.alt: PH Origins: a bottle of pale blue buffer solution beside pH test strips.
ph-origins.origin: The first category: acid-base balance, written to one indication.

sick-of-it.name: Sick of It
sick-of-it.alt: Sick of It: a single-use auto-injector in its case beside a thermometer.
sick-of-it.origin: Febrile emergency care, entered under the charter.

the-place-department.name: The Place Department
the-place-department.alt: The Place Department: locked filing cabinets and a records rack in a secure archive.
the-place-department.origin: Records storage, for a company that minutes everything.

imagine-live-tv.name: Imagine Live TV
imagine-live-tv.alt: Imagine Live TV: a broadcast camera and an anatomical heart model in a teaching studio.
imagine-live-tv.origin: Live medical education, the first product built for the quarterly report.

yooba-land.name: Yooba Land
yooba-land.alt: Yooba Land: a bottle of oral nutritional solution with a dosing cup and fresh fruit.
yooba-land.origin: Appetite support, added to the line in the same year.

i-can-be.name: I Can Be
i-can-be.alt: I Can Be: a white full-body scanner with its patient table.
i-can-be.origin: Diagnostic assessment, dated on the Zurich calendar.

dose-of-destruction.name: Dose Of Destruction
dose-of-destruction.alt: Dose Of Destruction: an infusion bag with a yellow handling band on a steel stand.
dose-of-destruction.origin: Oncology, released on a date that has not moved.

hawkes-gen.name: Hawkes Gen
hawkes-gen.alt: Hawkes Gen: an automated synthesis arm working over sample tubes.
hawkes-gen.origin: Laboratory services: on-demand synthesis, the eighth product in the line.
